The Flan Collection

dataset.flan-collection

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Actual complete primary creation-method/results/limits and pinned creator code/docs reads establish one derived FLANCollection dataset family. It reuses FLAN2021,P3/SNIand other tasks while adding named templates,input inversions,prompt-format variants,newdialog/reasoningdata and an explicit weighted mixture; distinct family identity does not imply disjoint original examples or fresh independent human annotation. The earlier author strict-independence hold is retained historically and corrected explicitly: frozenBrequires distinct source-backed family identity, not example-disjointness. No duplicate FLAN2021/2022family or submixture/constituent credits are proposed. Preserve experimental-versus-release template revisions, code/paper task-count differences and absent legally constrained program-synthesis/Taskmaster portions. Original exact qualified family subjectfacts retain actual3rolecurrentdigestproof; no fact wording, newscientific passes, data-generation/recount/modelrun or rights/contamination guarantees. Full_source means the available primary collection protocol/evaluation/version/limits documentation read here, not all upstream corpus review.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The Flan Collection · documents: The expanded Flan Collection combines prior instruction-task collections with prompt variants, input inversions and mixture weighting; the released example defines five principal submixtures.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.dataset.flan-collection.composite-family-identity

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Original Flan-2021, the expanded collection, task sources, templates and code are distinct levels. Strict independence from constituent families remains unresolved in the preserved baseline, so no additive family credit is claimed.

The Flan Collection · documents: The paper studies mixed prompt formats, task scaling, input inversion and source balancing using T5-XL and held-in, CoT and held-out MMLU/BBH evaluations.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.dataset.flan-collection.method-and-heldout-setup

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The paper warns that task definitions/counts vary and task quality/diversity matters. Held-out removal within this mixture is not a general pretraining-contamination audit.
